# hoardy.ai

> Hoardy is a Toronto-based boutique technology agency that builds AI agents and assistants, web and app products, product design, QA and maintenance, VR and immersive experiences, and the technical strategy behind them. We work with brands and founders across Toronto, Mississauga, the GTA and Canada, and with clients worldwide. Legal entity: 11371096 Canada Inc. Contact: maaz@hoardy.ai.

## About

- [Home](https://hoardy.ai/): what Hoardy does, who it works with, the six service lines, and the delivery process.
- [Services](https://hoardy.ai/services.md): every service line with scope, tags and who it is for, in markdown.
- [Contact](https://hoardy.ai/#contact): project enquiry form. We answer within a day.

Canada has just made agentic AI a national priority. Here is how we strategise, plan, and build agentic workflows that survive production, and what to ask before you hire a builder. (2026-09-30)
